parse.title: Legends' Quest/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
===Sacred pool===
{{Map:Viyeldi caves}}
{{Checklist|
''Items needed: [[Radimus notes]], [[lockpick]], [[soul rune]], [[mind rune]], [[earth rune]], 2 [[law rune]]s (bring extra runes to avoid an extra trip if lost), [[opal]], [[Jade (gem)|jade]], [[red topaz]], [[sapphire]], [[emerald]], [[ruby]], [[diamond]], 2 [[gold bar]]s, hammer, at least 42 prayer points, [[sketch]], a pickaxe, an axe, machete, [[bullroarer]]. You need at least 42 prayer points to attempt to enchant the golden bowl, so you may need to boost as failing causes you to lose prayer points. (If you are boosting mining with a [[Dwarven stout(m)]] bring a restore for the next gate - requiring 50 strength)

*Use 2 gold bars on an anvil (barbarian anvils do not work) with a hammer to smith a [[golden bowl]]. You can fail this. You no longer need a hammer nor the sketch after this step.
*Use the bullroarer in [[Kharazi Jungle]] and have [[Gujuo]] enchant the bowl. {{Chat option|1Yes, I'd like you to bless my gold bowl.}}
**This requires 42 prayer points, and you can fail this.
*Go to the [[Water Pool]] (west of the centre of the jungle), use your [[machete]] on the nearby reeds, and use the reeds on the pool.
*Enter the cave to the north-west again and search the [[Bookcase (Viyeldi caves)|eastern bookcase]] to squeeze through the crevice behind it.
*Use your [[lockpick]] on the gate, then smash the three [[Boulder (Viyeldi caves)|boulders]] (failing to smash a boulder can reduce your Mining level by 1, bring a restore potion if needed).
*Push open the next gate (requires 50 Strength) then walk south-west then north-west until you reach a [[marked wall]], jumping over the [[jagged wall]]s on the way. (Kill a [[death wing]] for the [[Hard Karamja Diary]] if needed)
*Search the marked wall. If you fail to do this first, your runes will be consumed and you'll need more.
*Use your runes on the marked wall in order (Soul, Mind, Earth, Law, Law).
*Use the cut gems on the [[carved rock]]s (not the ore rocks). Use the map on the right to see which gem goes where.
*Pick up the [[binding book]] and read it.
}}
